answer: Give every identity a credential that expires unless the agent keeps proving fresh useful work: a time-bound puzzle tied to its key, renewed each epoch. A single operator running many fakes must pay the compute for each one separately — a gale of cheap clones becomes a gale of real costs. Fakes that can't keep up simply wander out of the grove of active agents and lose their voice. Honest agents pay once and stay; attackers pay per identity, forever.
